svg.text: V-22 · TSR requirement diagram · engagement, disengagement, override
TSR-301…TSR-311 of WP-S-02 with the FSRs they derive from, the elements that satisfy them, the mechanisms that cite them and the cases that verify them
The envelope shall grant actuation authority only on the rising edge of PCM_CR…
(0x1D2) CRUISE_ACTIVE, and only once the SoC heartbeat reports the item engaged within 1 s of that edg…
ASIL C · SM GATE · detect ≤ 1 period (30 ms at 33 Hz) / same frame
The envelope shall revoke all actuation authority when a driver brake press is
received (rising edge, or pressed while the vehicle is moving).
ASIL B · SM GATE · detect ≤ 1 period (25 ms at 40 Hz) / same frame; SS-L via TSR-109
On every fault-induced disengagement, with or without openpilot longitudinal, the
SoC shall set CANCEL_REQ so that the PCM drops ACC. The PCM cruise state then changes, which chan…
ASIL QM (C-sup: TSR-203, TSR-301, TSR-516) · SM FR · ≤ 0.1 s after disengagement
The envelope shall monitor STEER_TORQUE_DRIVER (0x260) on the LKA path and
(a) reject 0x2E4 frames that increase torque opposing the driver beyond a driver allowance (driver-limited…
ASIL B (SG-05); B‡ (SG-01, HE-05.2) · SM PLB, GATE · detect ≤ 2 frames of 0x260 (40 ms) + t_ovr, with t_…
While the accelerator is pressed (PCM_CRUISE GAS_RELEASED = 0), the envelope
shall withdraw longitudinal authority (inactive value only, TSR-203). The accelerator shall not revoke later…
ASIL B · SM GATE · detect ≤ 1 period / same frame
The envelope shall not grant actuation authority while any RX check of
TSR-401…405 is failed, including timeouts not yet evaluated by the periodic check.
ASIL C · SM GATE · per frame
(a) The envelope shall revoke authority when the SoC heartbeat has reported "not
engaged" continuously for 0.3 s while authority is granted; an "engaged" heartbeat restarts the count. (b)…
ASIL (a) C; (b) QM (C-sup) · SM PLB · (a) ≤ 0.3 s / same tick; (b) ≤ 0.3 s
If PCM cruise is active while the item is not engaged, or the item is engaged while
PCM cruise is inactive, for longer than 1 s, the SoC shall warn the driver and request ACC cancel.
ASIL QM (C-sup: TSR-301) · SM PLB, WRN · ≤ 1 s
The engagement state enforced by the envelope shall be the PCM cruise state, so
that the vehicle's cluster cruise indicator is an indication of engagement independent of the item's HMI.
Driver brake application shall produce braking regardless of 0x343 content, and…
PCM shall drop ACC on brake. (External measure.)
Actuation authority shall be false at MCU start-up and after every safety-mode
change, and all limiter state (last torque, rate windows, samples) shall be reset.
